audience: service businesses that take appointments and bookings in eTermin

useCases.title: Check open slots for a service
useCases.text: Find the service and calendar ids. Then read the open booking slots on a day, or over a span of days.

useCases.title: Review appointments for a period
useCases.text: List the appointments in a date range, or the appointments of one contact found by email.

useCases.title: Check working times and absences
useCases.text: Read the weekly working times of a calendar, and its absences such as holidays.

useCases.title: Book an appointment
useCases.text: Find or create the contact, then book the appointment. By default the booking is refused when the slot is taken. An email goes out only when you ask.

useCases.title: Delete an appointment
useCases.text: Delete an appointment by its eTermin id or your external id. The customer gets an email only when you ask, and that needs the external id.
